content: Tanvi Saxena called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to inquire about renewing her auto policy (AP-001234). Neha informed her that the policy had actually expired on the 10th of the month. Tanvi asked about reinstatement options, and Neha explained she would need to pay the backdated premium along with a small reinstatement fee.

action_items: Provide a quote for policy reinstatement
Pay backdated premium and reinstatement fee
